precepts.text: The righteous is more excellent than his neighbour: but the way of the wicked seduceth them. You will not find scriptures where the righteous seduce; the wicked always seduce the righteous. This is why brothers and sisters meet somebody in the world and convince themselves they can win them over. That never happens. It is not what the Bible says.
precepts.point: On family: we do not break up families. If your family does not have an issue with you being in the scriptures and is not trying to manipulate your children, fine. But we will warn you if your family is saying come out of that Bible and go back to what you used to do. They will seduce you to go right back to the way you used to be, because that is what the scribes and the Pharisees were doing, and that is what the Christian preachers do.
precepts.why:
Who beguiles whom? Proverbs says: “The righteous is more excellent than his neighbour: but the way of the wicked seduceth them.” Although the righteous is more excellent than his neighbor, the wicked seduce them.

You will not find scriptures where the righteous seduce, because seduce is a word with a negative meaning. The wicked always seduce the righteous, not the other way around.

This is why brothers and sisters meet somebody in the world and convince themselves, because he or she is so good-looking: I can win them over. I think I can win him; I think I can win her. That never happens; it is not what the Bible says. Just give it time, and you'll be out. Enticing words flow from the wicked to the righteous, never back.

precepts.text: The decent sister thinks her scripture will rub off on the hard-headed one. It goes the other way.
precepts.point: Ten gained ten cities and five gained five, and the one who did nothing loses his one city to the brother with ten.

precepts.text: The hand of the diligent shall bear rule, but the slothful shall be under tribute; the other tribes were diligent and went and conquered their land.
precepts.point: We cannot sit back knowing Christ is coming and not do the work; the time is short, and this is not our rest. We have to bring our brothers and sisters to repentance.

note.label: Joshua 18: The Lots Cast at Shiloh

precepts.why:
“How long are ye slack to go to possess the land, which the Lord God of your fathers hath given you?” The land was already given; they were waiting instead of going in to possess it. Slack means lazy, slothful, full of excuses. “The hand of the diligent shall bear rule: but the slothful shall be under tribute.” The other tribes were diligent and went and conquered their land; the slothful sit and wait.

It is the same spirit a lot of our brothers and sisters have today: you have gifts you bring to the table, but you exercise them for your boss at work and are slack when it comes to the necessities of your nation. This shows we are the children of Israel, because that is the spirit we have, and we have to come out of that thing.

points: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes. So if you are a fool, if you are stupid, what you do is always going to be right in your eyes. Remember one of the signs is that he is always right. Everybody else is telling you, you are wrong, but in your eyes, no, I am right.

But he that hearkeneth unto counsel is wise. If you can take advice, if you can take correction, you are wise. That is what makes you wise. You see how God's law converts you. If you can take criticism even from your spouse — sisters, your husband is going to criticise you, he is going to tell you things you are doing that are not right. All you have got to do is listen. Do not fight against it.

note.label: The Mind of a Child: Void of Ego and Pride

points: A prudent man concealeth knowledge: but the heart of fools proclaimeth foolishness. If you are a fool, you are just going to talk foolishness, and your heart bears foolishness. What is that foolishness? Some of those seven things we just showed you. You do not want to take correction. You do not want to listen to anyone. You are arrogant.

note.label: The Mind of a Child: Void of Ego and Pride

points: Whoso loveth instruction loveth knowledge. If you love to be instructed, you love knowledge.

But he that hateth reproof is brutish. If you do not like to be corrected, if you do not like it when somebody tells you that was wrong what you did — the scripture says you are brutish. Brutish is stupid. Here is somebody trying to help you. You know you are doing something wrong, they say, that is wrong, stop doing that, and you hate that. You are a stupid person.

note.label: The Mind of a Child: Void of Ego and Pride

points: Lying lips are abomination to the Lord: but they that deal truly are his delight. Lying lips are an abomination to God. Deal truly. Deal just. Be honest. Even when you are in error, just be honest about it.

All manner of sin can be forgiven. But if you compound the sin with lies, you just dig a deeper hole. You do not fear God. And then you want to sit and guide the people and show them how to serve God. You have to be crazy. People are not going to serve you. People are not going to serve God correctly, not with that mentality. And then you want to reclaim your place and sit here and be the example on what to be, how to serve God. No, it does not work like that.

note.label: God's People Need Charity, Healing & Trust

points: The lip of truth shall be established for ever: but a lying tongue is but for a moment. The lip that teaches the law is going to be established for ever, for generations. So when the next leaders come, they will follow the same pattern.

But a lying tongue is but for a moment. It will fall apart. This whole thing will fall apart if I am here teaching in deceit and hypocrisy, if leadership is. But the lip that teaches the laws of God, that enforces the laws of God, that instructs the people, they are going to be the hedge to lead the people back on the right path, and it will continue for generations. This is about legacy. This is about repairing the breach and growing back, re-establishing the nation of Israel.

note.label: God's People Need Charity, Healing & Trust

points: Whoso loveth instruction loveth knowledge: but he that hateth reproof is brutish. So if you love instruction you love knowledge. But he that hateth reproof is brutish. Definition read in class: brutish, resembling or characteristic of a brute. A brute: a savagely violent person or animal. Savage, beast, monster, animal.

So let me give you a couple of signs of pride. Nobody can tell me anything. That is a sign of pride. You have brothers and sisters in the truth like that. I already know that. You have never met these brothers you tell something and they say, yeah, I already know, I know. That know-it-all brother. Why are they correcting me? That is a sign of pride. I deserve a higher position. We saw that in the restructuring we just did. What do you mean you deserve a higher position? Why is this brother over me, two years ago this brother got caught in adultery, why over me? Pride. He is over you because you have no idea what this is about. That is why he is over you.
There is that speaketh like the piercings of a sword: but the tongue of the wise is health. A lot of us are mad about something and go home and speak to our wives like the piercing of a sword.

Whoso loveth instruction loveth knowledge: being corrected is a good thing; that is how you grow. A lot of people do not like being around leadership because they know they will get stood up and asked questions, to see where their biblical knowledge and moral knowledge is. The elders and bishops are trying to build real strong righteous men, and you have to get corrected, because a lot of us lack these abilities.
But he that hateth reproof is brutish.

note.label: Character & Integrity: The Hidden Strength Behind Wisdom

points: The righteous is more excellent than his neighbour: but the way of the wicked seduceth them. It is impossible to sit among people who put you through traumatic experiences, or who remind you of the old life of drugs and drunkenness, and stay whole; those environmental cues reactivate what is stored. You have to separate yourself.

Some of you love your mama so much that you will sit at her house and hear her speak evil of what you believe, of your husband, of your lifestyle, and just take it, not knowing it is triggering and reactivating what you have been through. Around her you feel like that little child again who cannot say anything, and you will suppress the gospel to seek love. If they do not respect your beliefs, love them from a distance; do not keep bringing yourself back to that old place and hindering your walk in this truth.
